leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a Vue component that manages the active tab state using the Composition API
Implement child components that receive and respond to parent-provided context
Configure slot-based content distribution for dynamic tab panels
Bind click handlers to tab headers to control panel visibility
Integrate provide/inject patterns to share state between compound components
Manipulate CSS classes conditionally to visually indicate the active tab
Render a complete tab interface with interactive headers and corresponding content panels
